popCulture.title: Metamorphoses
popCulture.creator: Ovid
popCulture.description: Ovid's close of the Theban books — Cadmus praying to become a serpent, Harmonia joining him — fixes the founders' end as metamorphosis, not mere exile.

popCulture.title: Cadmus
popCulture.description: The Phoenician founder who sowed dragon's teeth and later left Thebes for Illyria — Harmonia's consort until both wear crested scales.

popCulture.title: Harmonia (mythology)
popCulture.description: Ares and Aphrodite's daughter, bride of Cadmus — concord that ends as twin serpents after the Labdacid disasters gather round their city.
